description: Return the authoritative AddressRiskReport Product Card JSON: what AddressRiskReport is (one plain-English PDF report for any US street address, built from official federal data - FEMA flood zone and Special Flood Hazard Area status, US Forest Service wildfire hazard potential, NOAA heat/storm context and FEMA National Risk Index, with map dates shown inside), who it is for, what is free (the FEMA flood-zone flag on the home page for an exact address point, no email; the browser-only Home Buyer Risk Checklist with 24 checks in 5 sections; the Home Risk Comparison Worksheet for 2-3 homes; the flood zone guide and the wildfire risk guide), the paid offers (full report $15 one-time for one address; 5-report pack $50 one-time; no account, no recurring charges), the honest limits (free flag is the current zone only, not a flood history; 'no mapped zone' is not 'no risk'; the report is not a lending or insurance determination, not a survey and not legal advice; no delivery time is promised), privacy and refund terms (30 days, with the stated exception for fully performed and delivered work). The Home Energy Audit ($29) is a separate product with its own card, not part of this report. Quote prices only from this card or the product site.
name: addressriskreport_get_product_card
